versions.content: If, for implementation reasons, some additional types have to be defined, the CanTp module shall label these types as follows: CanTp_<TypeName>Type, where <TypeName> is the name of this type adhering to the rules: - No underscore usage - First letter of each word upper case, consecutive letters lower case.
